scenario.title: The Rain at Ashcombe House
scenario.premise: During a rainbound country visit, a misdirected letter exposes a conflict of loyalties.
scenario.protagonist_role: A guest who notices the household's contradictions
scenario.tone: witty social observation, restrained tension, dialogue-led scenes
scenario.opening_text: Rain detained every guest at Ashcombe House, while an unsigned letter waited on the breakfast tray.
scenario.custom_prompt: Preserve player agency. Use original characters and wording; do not imitate or name any author.
scenario.player_action: I remain by the window and ask the housekeeper whether any letters arrived, without opening or accepting one.
